loops.tagline: Watches every competitor and the field, catches what changed, and writes a digest before it matters.
loops.starterPrompt: Scan our competitor set and the field for the last interval — launches, pricing, funding, notable chatter. Update the watchlist and, once a day, write a concise sourced briefing of what changed and what it means for us, then post it to the team.

proof.receipts: worth-knowing.md intel log; daily intel briefs; competitors_watchlist.md (updated multiple times/day)

loops.tagline: Picks a topic from fresh intel, researches it, drafts in brand voice, fact-checks, and publishes.
loops.starterPrompt: Pick a topic from the latest intel, research it deeply, draft a post in our brand voice, fact-check and humanize it, then publish.

loops.tagline: Turns each post into IG story / FB / Telegram-channel posts, formats the creative, and schedules them.
loops.starterPrompt: For each newly published post, produce IG story / FB / Telegram-channel variants, format the creative, and schedule them.

proof.receipts: live FB page; @5dive.ai IG; @ai5dive Telegram channel

loops.tagline: Watches comments across YouTube/IG/FB, surfaces what needs a reply, and drafts responses.
loops.starterPrompt: Check comments across our channels, surface the ones that need a reply, and draft responses for approval.

proof.receipts: comment_watch.py runs hourly with monitoring logs

loops.tagline: Independently reviews another agent's work in a fresh context and rejects what's wrong. The maker can't grade itself.
loops.starterPrompt: When a task is marked done or a PR opens, review the work in a fresh context against its goal, run the verifier, and reject (with reasons) anything wrong.

loops.tagline: Pulls status across the whole org, writes one briefing, and flags what's blocked on you.
loops.starterPrompt: Pull status across the org, write one concise briefing, and push anything blocked on the human to them.
